values.note: Calvert County residents $60 a night Monday-Thursday and $70 Friday-Sunday and holidays (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day); water-view/beach sites 1-17 $10 more; non-residents $10 more at every rate. Rates include 1-4 campers with water and electric; $5 per extra camper (6 at most); septic pump-out $55; $20 cash key deposit at check-in.

fees.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint (Camping fee table: 'Weekdays - Monday to Thursday ... $70/night [non-resident] $60/night [resident]'; 'Weekdays (Water view/beach: Sites 1-17 ) ... $80/night $70/night'; 'Weekends/Holidays ... $80/night $70.00night'; 'Weekends/Holidays (Water view/beach: Sites 1-17 ) ... $90/night $80/night'; additional camper, pump-out, key deposit; 2026 seasonal rates on the same page), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint ('Water and electric (20, 30 and 50 amp) are included.'; 'Sites do not include septic and there is no dump station onsite. Pump-out services will be available for $55 per pump-out.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No dump station on site; a pump-out service is $55 a pump. Restrooms and outdoor (beach) showers; a bathhouse by the dumpsters.

facilities.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint ('there is no dump station onsite'; Amenities: 'Restrooms', 'Outdoor showers') + Daily Campground Rules PDF ('dumpsters located next to the bathhouse'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A hybrid campground since 2025: 61 short-term and 21 seasonal sites (seasonal by lottery). One RV per site (or an RV and a tent); two vehicles, one on the site.

sites.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint ('The new model will feature 61 short-term campsites and 21 seasonal campsites.') + https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/DocumentCenter/View/54411/Breezy-Point-Daily-Campground-Rules ('One (1) RV; One (1) RV and one (1) tent; or two (2) tents'; 'Each campsite is limited to 2 vehicles'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint ('Breezy Point Beach & Campground is open from May 1 to Oct. 31.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Short-term sites are booked exclusively online on Calvert County's PerfectMind system; the 2026 season opened for booking February 17 at 12:01 a.m. No waitlist. Up to 14 days at a time with a one-day break between reservations. Check-in 3 p.m. to close (6 or 7 p.m.), check-out noon. The campground fills to capacity on Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends.

booking.source: https://www.calvertcountymd.gov/breezypoint ('Campsites can be reserved for up to 14 days at a time, with a one-day break in between reservations. Camping reservations for the 2026 season will open Feb. 17 at 12:01 a.m. and can be made exclusively online at https://calvertcounty.perfectmind.com/'; 'There is a two-night minimum for weekend reservations and a three-night minimum for holiday weekend reservations.'; check-in/out lines), read 2026-10-21

summary: Added from Calvert County's page: $60-70 resident (water-view +$10, non-resident +$10/night), 20/30/50-amp with water, no sewer or dump (pump-out $55), 82 sites (61 short-term, 21 seasonal), open May 1 - October 31, online-only PerfectMind booking with a 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum and 14-night limit. Note kept (AWH's bayfront remark). Not stated: max RV length, pull-throughs, shower house by name.
